map.。房地产交易受当地限购、信贷与税费政策影响，各城市执行口径存在差异，实际操作请以: . Real estate transactions are affected by local purchase restrictions, credit and tax policies, and enforcement rules differ between cities; for actual operations, follow the signed contract, the appraisal report and the regulations of the competent authority, and consult a professional valuer or broker for major decisions.
map.土地补偿费一般为前 3 年平均年产值 6–10 倍，安置补助费每人 4–6 倍，: Land compensation is generally 6-10 times the average annual output value of the previous 3 years, and the resettlement subsidy is 4-6 times that per person; the specifics follow the comprehensive land price of the provincial district.
map.填写「前三年平均年产值(元/亩)」。: Fill in "average annual output value of the first three years (CNY per mu)".
map.填写「地上附着物补偿(元)」。: Fill in "compensation for fixtures above ground (CNY)".
map.填写「被征收土地面积(亩)」。: Fill in "area of land being expropriated (mu)".
map.填写「需安置农业人口数」。: Fill in "number of agricultural people to be resettled".
map.填写「青苗补偿费(元/亩)」。: Fill in "young crop compensation (CNY per mu)".
map.征地项目测算土地补偿费、安置补助费与青苗补偿。: For land acquisition projects, compute land compensation, resettlement subsidies and young crop compensation.
map.征收补偿 = 区片价 × 面积: Expropriation compensation = district land price x area
map.核对补偿总额是否超过年产值 30 倍上限。: Check whether the total compensation exceeds the ceiling of 30 times the annual output value.
map.补偿不够生活怎么办？: What if the compensation is not enough to live on?
map.补偿倍数怎么定？: How are the compensation multiples set?
map.被征地农民核算人均安置补助是否合理。: For farmers whose land is expropriated, check whether the per-capita resettlement subsidy is reasonable.
map.规定土地与安置补助总和不得超过年产值 30 倍，若仍不足以保障原有生活水平，应经: The rules cap the sum of land and resettlement compensation at 30 times the annual output value; if that still fails to preserve the original living standard, the standard must be raised with approval or social security arranged.
map.集体土地征收补偿计算工具，根据土地补偿费、安置补助费、地上附着物补偿和青苗补偿费: Collective land expropriation compensation calculation tool: computes the total expropriation compensation from land compensation, resettlement subsidy, compensation for fixtures above ground and young crop compensation.
map.：前 3 年平均年产值 2000 元/亩、征收 50 亩、土地倍数 8 → 土地: : average annual output value of the first 3 years is 2000 CNY per mu, 50 mu expropriated and a land multiple of 8 give land compensation = 2000 x 8 x 50 = 800,000 CNY; a resettlement multiple of 5 with 30 people to resettle gives 2000 x 5 x 30 = 300,000 CNY; young crop compensation 1000 CNY per mu x 50 = 50,000 CNY; total 1,150,000 CNY.
map.：土地+安置补偿 = 年产值×(8+5×30/50)×50；若该和超过年产值×3: : land plus resettlement compensation = annual output x (8 + 5 x 30/50) x 50. If that sum exceeds annual output x 30 x 50 the cap is hit and the subsistence guarantee standard must be raised according to law.
